54	def parse_fixtures(makefile: Path) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
55	    """Extract fixture names + family from tests/fixtures/Makefile.

66	    var_pattern = re.compile(
67	        r"^(?P<var>[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*)\s*:?=\s*(?P<body>(?:[^\n]*\\\n)*[^\n]*)$",
68	        re.MULTILINE,

82	        body = m.group("body").replace("\\\n", " ")

1044	def _run_drain_at_exit_profile(elf: Path, artifacts: dict[str, Path],

1047	    """F14: run a profile pass that drains at program exit (no icount cap).
1048

1050	
1051	    The plugin's drain_at_exit=1 mode counts every retired insn via a
1052	    per-insn exec cb and overrides the drained state file's `minstret`
1053	    field with that count (QEMU's PMU minstret is host-tick-derived on
1054	    system-mode without -icount, which is why we use the plugin counter).
1055	    """
1056	    shm_path = _load_hsim_shm().allocate(
1057	        mmap_size, prefix="hsim-profile-shm.",
1058	    )
1059	    state_fd, state_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="hsim-profile-state.")
1060	    os.close(state_fd)
1061	    state_out = Path(state_name)
1062	    try:
1063	        argv = _qemu_drain_argv(
1064	            artifacts["qemu"], elf, artifacts["plugin"],
1065	            shm_path, mmap_size, state_out,
1066	            plugin_extras=(
1067	                f"bbv_out={bbv}",
1068	                f"slice={slice_n}",
1069	                "drain_at_exit=1",
1070	            ),
1071	        )
1072	        proc = subprocess.run(
1073	            argv, cwd=REPO_ROOT,
1074	            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
1075	            timeout=_PROFILE_TIMEOUT_S,
1076	        )
1077	        if proc.returncode != _QEMU_DRAIN_RC:
1078	            tail = proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()[-20:]
1079	            print(f"hsim: QEMU profile expected exit {_QEMU_DRAIN_RC}, "
1080	                  f"got {proc.returncode}", file=sys.stderr)
1081	            for line in tail:

1086	            print(f"hsim: profile produced empty BBV: {bbv}", file=sys.stderr)
1087	            return 1, 0
1088	        rows = sum(1 for _ in bbv.open())
1089

1100	                  f"(plugin counter unexpectedly zero)", file=sys.stderr)
1101	            return 1, 0
1102	
1103	        print(f"profile: {rows} BBV rows -> {bbv} (N_total={n_total})")
1104	        return 0, n_total
1105	    finally:

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Demo T3: icount switching mode (M3) end-to-end.
3	#
4	# Both QEMU1 and vsim switch via retired-instruction count alone, with
5	# no CSR markers in the workload:
6	#
7	#   QEMU1 + plugin icount=N1    -> drain at insn N1 (M3).
8	#   vsim --hybrid-icount N2     -> drain at insn N2 (M3).
9	#
10	# Workload is icount_spin.elf (CSR-less tight 2-insn RVC loop at 0x100002
11	# and 0x100004). Neither side could use csrwi 0x7C0 -- icount IS the
12	# only available drain trigger. There is no natural semihosting exit
13	# (icount_spin spins forever), so this demo asserts the round-trip
14	# DRAINS correctly at both ends; M8 is exercised by T1 / T2 / T6.
15	#
16	# Env (auto-detected with sensible defaults):
17	#   VSIM_QEMU     qemu-system-riscv64
18	#   VSIM_PLUGIN   libhybrid_handoff.so
19	#   VSIM_BIN      sim_<cpu>
20	#   VSIM_ELF      CSR-less fixture (default: icount_spin.elf)
21	#   QEMU_ICOUNT   plugin icount drain target (default: 10000)
22	#   VSIM_ICOUNT   vsim icount drain target  (default: 5000)
23	
24	set -euo pipefail
25	
26	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
27	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"
28	
29	FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-icount_spin}"
30	QEMU_ICOUNT="${QEMU_ICOUNT:-10000}"
31	VSIM_ICOUNT="${VSIM_ICOUNT:-5000}"
32	
33	MODE_LABEL="Icount switching (M3)"
34	echo "=========================================================="
35	echo "Mode: $MODE_LABEL"
36	echo "Fixture: ${FIXTURE} (CSR-less tight loop)"
37	echo "QEMU1 trigger: plugin icount=$QEMU_ICOUNT"
38	echo "vsim  trigger: --hybrid-icount $VSIM_ICOUNT  (CSR matcher disabled)"
39	echo "=========================================================="
40	
41	hybrid_resolve_paths
42	
43	SHM_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
44	SHM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-icount-rt.XXXXXX)
45	STATE_Q=$(mktemp)
46	STATE_V=$(mktemp)
47	QEMU_LOG=$(mktemp)
48	VSIM_LOG=$(mktemp)
49	trap 'rm -f "$SHM" "$STATE_Q" "$STATE_V" "$QEMU_LOG" "$VSIM_LOG"' EXIT
50	truncate -s "$SHM_SIZE" "$SHM"
51	
52	read_u64() { python3 -c "
53	import struct
54	with open('$1', 'rb') as f:
55	    f.seek($2); print(struct.unpack('<Q', f.read(8))[0])
56	"; }
57	
58	echo "[demo M3 1/2] QEMU1 + plugin icount=$QEMU_ICOUNT -> drain"
59	set +e
60	timeout 30 "$VSIM_QEMU" \
61	  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHM,size=$SHM_SIZE" \
62	  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
63	  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
64	  -nographic \

68	  >"$QEMU_LOG" 2>&1

75	fi

83	  echo "[demo M3] FAIL: QEMU1 drained pc=$PC_Q_HEX not in icount_spin loop"; exit 1

85	echo "  QEMU1 drain: pc=$PC_Q_HEX"
86	
87	echo "[demo M3 2/2] vsim --hybrid-icount $VSIM_ICOUNT -> drain"
88	set +e
89	timeout 120 "$VSIM_BIN" "$VSIM_ELF" \
90	  --resume-from-qemu "$STATE_Q" \
91	  --handoff-out "$STATE_V" \
92	  --hybrid-icount "$VSIM_ICOUNT" \
93	  >"$VSIM_LOG" 2>&1
94	VRC=$?
95	set -e
96	
97	if [ "$VRC" -ne 200 ]; then
98	  echo "[demo M3] FAIL: vsim expected exit 200, got $VRC"
99	  tail -20 "$VSIM_LOG"; exit 1
100	fi
101	if [ ! -s "$STATE_V" ]; then
102	  echo "[demo M3] FAIL: vsim state empty"; exit 1
103	fi
104	
105	PC_V=$(read_u64 "$STATE_V" 16)
106	PC_V_HEX=$(printf "0x%x" "$PC_V")
107	if [ "$PC_V_HEX" != "0x100002" ] && [ "$PC_V_HEX" != "0x100004" ]; then

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# End-to-end roundtrip harness: QEMU 1 + plugin -> vsim -> QEMU 2.
3	#
4	# Memory between QEMU and vsim is shared via an /dev/shm-backed mmap
5	# (128 MB). Works for both asm fixtures (handoff_roundtrip, rt_*) and
6	# C-level fixtures (rt_c_*). C fixtures require shared mmap so the
7	# stack/heap survives handoffs; asm fixtures don't need it but run
8	# fine with it.
9	#
10	# Env:
11	#   FIXTURE         REQUIRED. .elf name under tests/fixtures/ (no .elf suffix).
12	#   EXPECT_RC       Final exit code to assert (default 0).
13	#   TRIGGER_MODE    csr | pc (default csr).
14	#   ROI_START       pc mode only. Switch-in PC: a 0x address or a symbol in
15	#                   $VSIM_ELF (default: _hybrid_enter_pc).
16	#   ROI_END         pc mode only. Switch-out PC, same forms
17	#                   (default: _hybrid_exit_pc).
18	#   TIMEOUT         vsim leg timeout in seconds (default 60).
19	#   CHECK_MCYCLE_MONOTONIC=1   assert mcycle/minstret strictly increased
20	#                              between QEMU 1's drain and vsim's drain.
21	#   VSIM_BIN, VSIM_QEMU, VSIM_PLUGIN, VSIM_ELF, NM  override built paths.
22	
23	set -euo pipefail
24	
25	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
26	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/paths.sh"
27	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/roi.sh"
28	
29	FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:?FIXTURE env var is required (e.g. FIXTURE=rt_c_hello)}"
30	EXPECT_RC="${EXPECT_RC:-0}"
31	TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-60}"
32	TRIGGER_MODE="${TRIGGER_MODE:-csr}"
33	
34	hybrid_resolve_paths
35	
36	NM="${NM:-${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:+$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-nm}}"
37	NM="${NM:-riscv64-unknown-elf-nm}"
38	
39	case "$TRIGGER_MODE" in
40	  csr) ;;
41	  pc)
42	    if ! command -v "$NM" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
43	      echo "skip[$FIXTURE pc]: nm not found at $NM"
44	      exit 77
45	    fi
46	    NM_OUT=$("$NM" --defined-only "$VSIM_ELF")
47	    # ROI_START / ROI_END (env) name the two switch PCs: each is a 0x address
48	    # or a symbol in $VSIM_ELF. Default to the planted _hybrid_enter_pc /
49	    # _hybrid_exit_pc markers, so existing fixtures need no change.
50	    roi_resolve_pair "$NM_OUT" "$FIXTURE pc" || exit 1
51	    ;;
52	  *)
53	    echo "FAIL[$FIXTURE]: unknown TRIGGER_MODE=$TRIGGER_MODE (use csr|pc)"
54	    exit 1
55	    ;;
56	esac
57	
58	# 128 MB matches the QEMU virt machine default; vsim uses the same size.
59	SHARED_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
60	SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-e2e-shared.XXXXXX)
61	STATE_QEMU=$(mktemp)
62	STATE_VSIM=$(mktemp)
63	SIM_LOG=$(mktemp)
64	trap 'rm -f "$SHARED_MEM" "$STATE_QEMU" "$STATE_VSIM" "$SIM_LOG"' EXIT
65	truncate -s "$SHARED_SIZE" "$SHARED_MEM"
66	
67	PLUGIN_ARGS="outfile=$STATE_QEMU"
68	VSIM_TRIG_ARGS=()
69	if [ "$TRIGGER_MODE" = "pc" ]; then
70	  PLUGIN_ARGS="$PLUGIN_ARGS,enter_pc=0x$ENTER_PC"
71	  VSIM_TRIG_ARGS=(--hybrid-exit-pc "0x$EXIT_PC")
